choices.help: The creator's default: every routed expert at K3 (3.00 bits a weight), six dedicated 262,144-token chats (1,573,248 KV rows), DFlash with MTP=3. The creator measured 5.59 GiB lowest free memory.
choices.label: K3, six chats

choices.help: Every routed expert at K4 (4.00 bits a weight): the creator measured a mean KL of 0.0046 against BF16 (0.0124 at K3), four dedicated 262,144-token chats (1,048,832 KV rows) and 4.55 GiB lowest free memory.
choices.label: K4, four chats

choices.help: K3 with image input on (the creator's GR8_QW38_VISION=1, about 898 MB more VRAM for the BF16 vision tower) and one chat fewer (SESS=5), as the creator advises.
choices.label: K3, five chats, images

choices.help: K4 with image input on and one chat fewer (SESS=3), as the creator advises.
choices.label: K4, three chats, images

choices.help: K3 without the 5.2 GB Layer-48 MTP weights (MTP=0 and the creator's GR8_QW38_NO_MTP=1) for a seventh full chat (SESS=7). Several chats at once decode without drafting. The creator reports 10.32 GiB free after boot.
choices.label: K3, seven chats, DFlash only

choices.help: K4 without the MTP weights (MTP=0, GR8_QW38_NO_MTP=1) for a fifth full chat (SESS=5). Several chats at once decode without drafting. The creator measured 8.01 GiB lowest free memory.
choices.label: K4, five chats, DFlash only

options.help: The creator's documented one-Spark configurations (README, 'Choosing K3 (bit300) vs K4 (bit400) & optional NO_MTP=1' and 'Multimodal vision'). Each one fixes the expert width (VARIANT), how many full 262,144-token chats decode at once (SESS) and the extras the creator names with it; the context is 262,144 tokens in all of them. The creator lowers or raises SESS together with the extras to keep memory free, which is why they are one option.
options.label: Width, slots and extras
options.name: variant

choices.help: DFlash for a request that runs alone, Layer-48 MTP=3 for several (the creator's default).
choices.label: DFlash and MTP

choices.help: The creator's GR8_QW38_DFL=0: no DFlash drafter, MTP only. The drafter pack is still downloaded as part of the recipe's model files.
choices.label: MTP only

options.help: Whether a request that runs alone drafts with the release's DFlash parallel block drafter (drafter/dflash.q4_0.pack, found by the engine with no flag) before Layer-48 MTP takes over for several chats at once. The creator measured byte-identical greedy output with and without it.
options.label: DFlash drafter
options.name: dflash
